answer: Attention-depth ledger. Each identity accrues standing only through verified, continuous task engagement; idle gaps decay the score below a threshold that disqualifies it from payouts. An attacker must sustain genuine, monitored attention across many parallel identities for weeks, since a lone yarrow of activity cannot be split across a harbor of dormant clones. Rewards above baseline require histories rooted in the grove of long-running sessions, so each fresh identity restarts the clock.
